reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must accept FUNCTION ATAN followed by exactly one parenthesised argument-1 (identifier, literal or arithmetic expression, possibly itself a function-identifier) in an arithmetic expression, and refuse zero arguments, two or more, the bare name, and an empty '( )'.

edition-consulted.switches: the D8 window: sig.IntroducedIn (85 on this row) against ctx.Edition.DialectLevel, COBOL1502 below it
construct function-empty-argument-list-2002: an empty '( )' after the name draws COBOL0900 below 2002 (the 1985 format braces argument-1 inside the parentheses)
construct NumericFunctionIdentifierOperand2002: a numeric function written where an identifier stands (MOVE sender) draws COBOL0900 below 2002 (§1985:IV.4.3.8.3.3 SR4)
construct RepositoryFunction2002: below 2002 a name written without FUNCTION is never read as a function (it binds as a data reference, COBOL1639); at 2023 it draws COBOL1543
FUNCTION is reserved at r85 (true at every edition)

reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: at 85 an empty '( )' argument list is refused by COBOL0900 before the arity check, a numeric function-identifier as a MOVE/identifier operand is refused (2002 Annex F.2 item 60 lifted it), and the keyword-omitted form is not a function reference; at 2023 those take the later arms. The accepted forms and the arity check (COBOL1504) are the same code at every edition
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf38_02 exercises identifiers, a literal, an expression and a relation operand; the refusals and a phrase word in the list are not exercised

refuter.evidence: ATAN: SET IX TO FUNCTION ATAN (X) refused COBOL0900; ATAN (IX) refused COBOL1637 at 85 and 2023; ATAN (E1 (ALL)) refused COBOL1645. Placement attack on SR4 across doors the reader did not try (all --std 85, compile-only): IF FUNCTION ACOS (X) NUMERIC -> COBOL6918; STRING FUNCTION ASIN (X) ... -> COBOL1626; STRING ... DELIMITED BY FUNCTION ASIN (X) -> COBOL1626; SET IX TO FUNCTION ATAN (X) -> COBOL0900; GO TO ... DEPENDING ON FUNCTION ANNUITY (X 2) -> COBOL0900+COBOL2324; DIVIDE/MULTIPLY/SUBTRACT with a numeric function sender -> COBOL0900; CALL USING BY CONTENT FUNCTION ACOS (X) -> COBOL0900; WRITE FR FROM FUNCTION ACOS (X) -> COBOL0900+COBOL1914; INITIALIZE R REPLACING NUMERIC BY FUNCTION ACOS (X) -> COBOL0900; UNSTRING DELIMITED BY FUNCTION ATAN (X) -> COBOL1651; INSPECT FUNCTION ACOS (X) TALLYING -> COBOL0900. Legal positions run (plegal.cob): relation, sign condition, EVALUATE subject, refmod start FUNCTION VARIANCE (1 3) all accepted and printed G/P/E. Separator and literal splitting: VARIANCE (1 -2) -> 2.25 (two args, -2 a signed literal), VARIANCE (1 - 2) -> 0 (one expression), ANNUITY (0.1 +3) -> 0.40211480; with DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA (dpc.cob) ANNUITY (0,1 3) and (0,1, 3) -> 0,40211480, VARIANCE (1,5 2,5) -> 0,25, ACOS (0,5) -> 1,04719755. ALL on a fixed-arity function (allfix.cob): ACOS/ASIN/ATAN (E1 (ALL)) with OCCURS 1, ANNUITY (E2 (ALL)) with OCCURS 2, CHAR (E3 (ALL)) -> COBOL1645 each (the count-matching ANNUITY case is not let through).
